facts.text: The University of Akron Tuition Guarantee Program guarantees that undergraduate tuition, select fees, and room and board rates remain fixed for four years.

sources.title: UA's Tuition Guarantee Program : The University of Akron, Ohio
sources.quote: The University of Akron provides the certainty that tuition, select fees and room and board rates will not increase for degree-seeking undergraduate students for four years.
